summary_text: On 2026-03-27 (weekday), a single order was placed in the afternoon. The basket contained 13 items across 8 categories, emphasizing fresh produce (6 Vegetables) and dairy (1 Milk, 1 Curd Yogurt). Additional items included 1 Baby Cereal, 1 Cake Pastry, 1 Fruits, 1 Savouries Namkeens, and 1 Breads. The order-building behavior reflects a mix of staple fresh foods and prepared/consumable items, suggesting a need for fresh produce, dairy staples, and basic pantry items for meal preparation or consumption.
